name: Retro Coder 2000
summary:
It's 1991. Your brother is gone. What he left is his room, a beige PC, a dial-up modem, a stack of floppies and a rent bill with a deadline.

THE PC IS REAL
Boot it, install games from floppies, buy a faster CPU, video card and hard disk and switch them on in the BIOS. Everything runs on a simulated machine, and every program can be opened and changed.

WORK THE LINE
